workbench.title: Text game author workbench
workbench.sampleBlurb: The sample includes 3 chapters, 25 nodes, 45 beats, 30 choices, 2+ convergences, conditional options, and 3 endings.
workbench.emptyIntro: Start from a two-node blank game or load the full acceptance sample to learn conditions, effects, and convergence.
workbench.contractBody: gameKey, node keys, beat keys, and choice keys stay stable after creation; players read only the immutable GameRelease, and draft edits never rewrite old saves.
workbench.nodeDeleteConfirmMessage: Beats inside the node and choices pointing to or from it are deleted together.
workbench.beatsSubheading: Shows narration, dialogue, action, and system notes in order
workbench.choicesSubheading: Choices are the only official execution edges; legacy node successors do not run in new releases.
workbench.unavailableReasonPlaceholder: Shown when requirements are not met
workbench.graphValidMessage: Content graph is ready to publish
workbench.graphStatsLine: {{reachable}}/{{total}} nodes reachable · {{reachableEndings}}/{{endings}} endings reachable · {{cycles}} cycle warnings
workbench.previewNote: Preview reuses real event-replay conditions, effects, and node-entry semantics, but creates no SIM save, writes no events, and never poses as a release.
workbench.previewEmptyTitle: Pick a start point to preview the draft
workbench.previewEmptyIntro: Walk the whole path from the module entry, or spot-check content from mid-path nodes.
workbench.pipeline1Body: Entry, broken links, targets, reachability, endings, dead ends, cycles, and JSON syntax.
workbench.pipeline2Body: Uses the existing world release system to freeze the registry-derived portable snapshot.
workbench.pipeline3Body: Binds the world hash and freezes the GameDefinition, nodes, beats, and choices.
workbench.versionsSubheading: Old versions are always kept; existing player saves stay bound to the original content hash
workbench.noReleasesIntro: Run the check first, then publish the first immutable version.
workbench.help1Body: Each game binds one NarrativeModule. Keep a single entry and at least one reachable ending before expanding middle scenes.
workbench.help2Body: Narration, action, and system notes need no character; dialogue must pick a character from the current World. Order controls display.
workbench.help3Body: Choices are the only execution edges in new releases, with display conditions, availability conditions, unavailable reasons, and set/increment/unset effects.
workbench.help4Body: Spot-check local semantics from any node; before releasing, ensure everything is reachable from the entry and non-ending nodes have no dead ends.
workbench.help5Body: Every content change goes into a new world revision and GameRelease. Old releases, saves, and branches are never overwritten.
workbench.help6Title: AI still follows the unified Harness
workbench.help6Body: AI is not required in this phase. Future author assistance enters only via CONTEXT_SOURCES, FIELD_REGISTRY/Adoption, and the unified Harness.
workbench.recommendedPathBody: Load the acceptance sample → inspect beats/choices in content → run checks in paths → preview different routes → publish → switch to player mode and start a save.
workbench.createdBlankMessage: Created a minimal publishable story; keep expanding it in the content editor.
workbench.createdSampleMessage: Loaded the three-chapter acceptance sample: 25 nodes, 45 beats, 30 choices, 3 endings.
workbench.draftDeletedMessage: Draft and its dedicated content deleted; old releases remain playable.
workbench.checkPassedMessage: Content graph check passed; ready to publish.
workbench.loadFailedError: Failed to load the author workbench
workbench.draftDeleteConfirmMessage: The dedicated NarrativeModule, nodes, beats, and choices are deleted together; shared modules, published versions, and player saves remain untouched.
workbench.publishConfirmMessage: This will freeze a new WorldRevision, WorldRelease, and immutable GameRelease in turn; old versions and saves are not overwritten.

workbench.sidebarNote: Content lives in the AdventureModule; releases reuse WorldRevision, WorldRelease, and the unified GameRelease.
workbench.title: Text adventure author workbench
workbench.subtitle: TEXTADV-1 · DETERMINISTIC ADVENTURE
workbench.emptyIntro: The acceptance template provides 6 locations, 4 quests, item/resource/ability checks, alternate solutions, and three state-driven endings.
workbench.contractBody: World facts come from the WorldRelease; the story uses NarrativeModule/Node/Beat/Choice; runtime state writes only to the SIM event stream; free-form AI input yields only action-key candidates awaiting confirmation.
workbench.draftValidMessage: Structure, references, reachability, and alternate quest routes are valid.
workbench.statePreviewHeading: Inspect the initial playable state from any location
workbench.diagnosticsIntro: Checks broken links, invalid targets, unreachable locations/nodes, stuck quests, missing endings, and cycle risks.
workbench.releaseContractBody: The current WorldRevision and Narrative/Adventure content are copied into a hashed GameRelease; player instances always bind to that immutable version.
workbench.sampleCreatedMessage: Created a publishable acceptance adventure with locations, items, abilities, quests, checks, and three endings.
workbench.validatedMessage: Content graph, quest graph, and the shared Narrative graph all passed release validation.
workbench.publishedMessage: Froze GameRelease v{{version}}; later draft edits cannot change this release.
workbench.deleteConfirmMessage: The AdventureModule and dedicated Narrative draft are cleaned up; immutable releases and existing saves stay replayable.
workbench.deletedMessage: Draft deleted; past releases stay frozen.
